create_ovmm_llm_agent: create an OvmmLLMAgent instance with config to run a CLIP-based open-vocab manipulation agent
run_act_method: run the act method on OvmmLLMAgent with an Observations object to get navigation actions
segment_goal_object: segment a goal object from semantic observations using the _segment_goal method
update_clip_memory: update robot memory with CLIP features by calling _update_memory on the agent
get_skill_one_hot: get a one-hot dictionary for a Skill enum value using get_skill_as_one_hot_dict
